ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AD$ bisects $\angle CAB$, $BD=2CD$, and the distance from point D to $AB$ is 5.6. What is the length of $BC$ in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, construct DE $\perp$ AB at E, \\
$\because$ $\angle C=90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ CD $\perp$ AC, \\
$\because$ AD bisects $\angle$BAC, \\
$\therefore$ CD = DE, \\
$\because$ the distance from D to AB is equal to 5.6 cm, \\
$\therefore$ CD = DE = 5.6 cm, \\
Furthermore, $\because$ BD = 2CD, \\
$\therefore$ BD = 11.2 cm, \\
$\therefore$ BC = 5.6 + 11.2 = $\boxed{16.8}$ cm,
